"A pre-historic Moai that looks like it does not belong here... Why is it in perfect condition, yet so old? Why does it whisper? What truths may it contain?"

Description

GIGANTIC MOAI is a very big moai statue that can be found on the Pi island as well as the big rocks.

Map of the island

Trivia

  • The Gigantic Moai is 46 studs tall and weighs 90 tons.
  • You can get it in a single copy.
  • He looks like a regular moai, only big in size and has a big smile.

Updates

  • On the Flight update (v112.0), The helicopter was able to winch the gigantic moai! This made transporting it ALOT easier.
